Name: Convenient Town
Author: DaisyNiko
Description:
[b]- features -[/b]

* open pen so you can go in and say hi to dusty
* access to the field behind joja mart
* stairs from the river to the mountain path
* another bridge across the river
* bush removed from next to sewer so horse can fit through
* fencepost removed from graveyard so you can fit behind the tree


[b]- installation -[/b]

1. download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]smapi [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patcher[/url]
2. unzip mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods
3. run the game with smapi
